text: ピョンって　とぶのとっ！

patterns.name: 〜と (how)
patterns.explanation: と after a sound word tells how the action goes; って is its casual form. ピョンって とぶ = 'jump with a little hop'.

patterns.name: 〜の (one)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb can stand in for a thing already being talked about, like 'one' or 'ones'; here it means Pokémon. とぶの = 'ones that jump'.
